paragraphs: Mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Megillah, at the locator כפ״א, read here as chapter 1, in the reading Hyman attributes to the Rif, reporting Rabbi Shila of Kefar Tamarta. Our text has Rabbi Chanina bar Papa. Hyman explains that the error arose when a chet became yod-vav.

notes.text: The source prints כפ״א, read contextually as chapter 1. שמן ח׳ is “that from chet,” introducing Hyman’s letter-confusion explanation; no fresh scan proof is claimed.
The printed locator כפ״א is read contextually as chapter 1 here. Hyman reports the Rif’s reading and explains the variant through a proposed confusion between the letters.
